title: A script source of 200,000 characters or more cannot be set, so split generated data
observation: An exporter wrote one Luau module per asset holding its mesh arrays; one came out at 592,318 characters. Setting it as a ModuleScript's Source from a Studio plugin context failed with 'Provided string length (592318) is greater than or equal to max length (200000)'; Rojo's live sync sets sources the same way. Writing one module per material group, and cutting groups over 2,200 triangles, kept every module under 165,000 characters.
recommendation: Make any generator that writes Luau data assert each file's length is under 200,000 characters and split by a natural unit (a group, a chunk) when it is not; check the largest file in tests.
applies_when: Generating Luau modules from tools (meshes, layouts, tables of data) that are synced by Rojo or a plugin
limits: A Rojo build to a place file was not tested with an oversized module

evidence.detail: Sections 1 and 9: the 590,000-character module and the split.
